summary: Genetically Modified Mustard (DMH-11) environmental release challenged; approval validity under Environment Protection Act, 1986; application of precautionary principle; examination of GEAC's conditional approval dated 10/18/2022; compliance with biosafety protocols; public trust doctrine in environmental governance; right to safe environment under Article 21; analysis of expert committee reports; constitutional validity of regulatory framework; biosafety data transparency and public consultation issues; GEAC approval upheld with mandated monitoring protocols.
final_judgment: Approval for environmental release of GM Mustard DMH-11 permitted subject to strict compliance with biosafety and monitoring protocols; enhanced transparency measures directed.
